svg.aria-label: ANSI31 in a 200 mm wall of a millimetre drawing. At scale 1 the lines are 3.175 mm apart and read as solid grey; at scale 12 they are about 38 mm apart and read as hatching; at scale 100 they are 317.5 mm apart and most of the wall is empty.
svg.text: Hatch scale decides whether a pattern is visible
ANSI31 is 45° lines 0.125 in apart at scale 1; metric drawings (MEASUREMENT 1) use 3.175 mm. Spacing = 3.175 mm × scale.
